study: G4 E5 exact gallery richness, deduplication, and cap necessity
primary_endpoint: macro Dice over the 184 canonical validation tumor images on the native grid
exact_prompt_rule: Choose the prompt containing the maximum frozen upstream-score candidate in the pre-dedup bank; lower original candidate index resolves ties. Use this identical prompt for the one-mask and three-multimask arms.
single_mask_definition: Official SAM ViT-B with multimask_output=false for the exact frozen prompt.
multimask_definition: Official SAM ViT-B with multimask_output=true; exactly three masks for the same prompt.
selector: Frozen G1 checkpoint plus equal 0.5/0.5 average percentile-rank fusion; single-candidate arms need no learned selection.
deduplication: First occurrence of each byte-exact 320x320 binary mask is retained; input order is anchor then classifier448 addition.

cap.retention_order: descending frozen upstream score with lower original index tie-break

reported_metrics: generation runtime, peak VRAM, and output bytes
